model_choice_reason: Security-sensitive protocol routing and recovery compatibility without typed pause downgrade
requirements: Fix four shared production paths: checkpoint ingest, ACK, turn.paused, offline terminal recovery. Select mode from Host-frozen request and immutable profile before worker frames, not from untrusted frame contents. Known explicit RESEARCHOS_PAUSE_V1 stays strict. Unknown protocol values refuse.

Legacy bounded inline checkpoint/context rebuild may work only for non-Mu profile with no pause protocol negotiation. Mu with no V1 may continue ordinary existing operation but must not use legacy checkpoint fallback. Do not reject every old installed Mu normal turn at StartBridge.

Explicit V1 never falls back for missing/bad metadata, inline checkpoint, empty paused payload or weak ACK; preserve <=12MiB capture vs <=64KiB frame, no-reparse/file/hash/binding/epoch and typed artifact/use/journal seal. Reject mixed legacy/V1 protocol.

Offline recovery must corroborate selected mode against trusted immutable request bytes/input hash and frozen manifest profile as appropriate; journal mode erasure/tamper cannot downgrade V1 to legacy. Preserve terminal stopped/drain/cleanup/exit checks and legacy crash recovery.

Do not change old domain tests to accommodate breakage. Run original TestRuntimeCoordinatorCheckpointResume and TestRuntimeCoordinatorCheckpointCrashRecovery unchanged and native V1 bridge protocol/ACK/current candidate bundle regressions plus cross-mode negatives. Legacy result remains native_resume=false.

Exact two Source paths only; no schema/Core/SDK/worker/M1-02 changes, no Main/package/productDB/process/API/model changes. Independent review required. New D sparse worktree, D shared cache/unique temp, no new C worktree/cache. All failures retained, no task counters reset.
